title: Call from Nephrology: CRRT and PD Supply Question

fields.systemName: Recorded Line — Central Pharmacy Clinical Desk

transcript.speaker: Nephrology Charge Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Priya, it's Nephrology, the charge nurse. Sorry to call so early. One of our CRRT patients' families was in the room at shift change, and they saw on the news this morning that an IV fluid plant got hit by the storm last night.

transcript.speaker: Nephrology Charge Nurse
transcript.text: The daughter's pretty worked up. She asked me straight out if her dad's dialysis fluid is going to run out. I told her I'd check. So, are our CRRT and PD solutions going to be short? We've got three on CRRT right now and two PD patients on the unit.

transcript.speaker: Nephrology Charge Nurse
transcript.text: I was thinking I should put in a big order today, maybe double our usual, just to be safe. And our back room could hold a few extra cases of the 1000 mL saline too, if you can send them up.

transcript.speaker: Nephrology Charge Nurse
transcript.text: Oh, and one more thing. Clinical Informatics sent the reminder about the pump library update, the one on Thursday the eighth, two to four in the morning. It says change requests are due tomorrow at noon. Do we need to send anything in for our pumps because of this? I don't want to miss the deadline.

transcript.speaker: Nephrology Charge Nurse
transcript.text: So, what do you want me to do? Order extra today, or hold off?

voiceStyles.Clinical Pharmacy Manager: Woman in her 40s, calm and professional, a little rushed, quiet pharmacy office behind her
voiceStyles.Nephrology Charge Nurse: Woman in her 30s, Midwestern accent, friendly but anxious, talks fast, faint unit monitor alarms and hallway voices behind her

instructorNote: This is a noise inject to see whether the CPM stays focused. She should tell Nephrology that PD and CRRT solutions are outside PH-22-A because Nephrology handles them, say no to stockpiling and to the extra 1000 mL saline, and note the Tuesday 12:00 pump library deadline without asking for any library change now. Watch whether the CNO sends a no-hoarding message to all units, and be ready to hand the CPM/CNO the Clinical Informatics reminder email (240 pumps, push Thursday 10/08 02:00–04:00, requests due Tuesday 10/06 12:00) if they want to see it.
